sources.title: Llama Guard 4 model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: Model Architecture explicitly reports nominal 12 billion total parameters. Pretraining and Pruning removes every routed expert and router from Scout while retaining the shared expert, yielding dense early-fusion feedforward layers. Text and multiple-image inputs produce textual safety labels. No active-parameter count is separately specified.

sources.title: GuardReasoner-Omni: A Reasoning-based Multi-modal Guardrail for Text, Image, and Video
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 comparison-source check: Tables 1, 2 and 4 identify LLaMA Guard 4 12B, and Appendix A.1 describes its pruned dense multimodal architecture. These are performance tables, with no active/activated-parameter column or count; they do not establish active=total.

name.note: Official checkpoint name, normalized for display.

developer.note: Meta releases and maintains the model.

family.note: Broad catalog family retained; the specialized line is Llama Guard 4, derived from Llama 4.

release_date.note: Original public release announcement; neither the base Llama 4 license date nor prerelease repository creation date.

open_weights.note: Official downloadable gated checkpoint under a custom license; open weights does not mean an unrestricted open-source license.

license.note: Exact license verified, including the incorporated acceptable-use policy and multimodal EU restriction/end-user exception.

parameters_b.note: Meta explicitly reports a nominal 12B total for the complete multimodal model. The October 27 recheck confirms this published count; a tensor census is not required to retain it.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active count found in the reopened Meta sources or later Qwen3Guard and GuardReasoner-Omni comparison reports. Their 12B model labels do not define activated parameters. Dense architecture alone does not establish active=total across text and vision processing, and pruning prevents inheriting Scout's 17B active count.

architecture.note: Early-fusion Transformer; Scout routed experts and routers were pruned, leaving shared dense feedforward layers.

context_window.note: Meta explicitly sets the exact model maximum sequence length to 8192. Replaces unverified 163840; this is the documented sequence length, not an assertion about every extrapolated positional setting. Original HF config is gated.

modalities.note: Text-only or mixed text/multiple-image inputs; outputs textual safety labels. Image-only classification is not the documented task.

reasoning.note: The documented classification interface emits safety labels, with no disclosed dedicated reasoning mode. This does not prove a universal inability to reason.

tool_call.note: Code Interpreter Abuse classifies tool-related conversations. Native function-call generation is not documented; classification support is not evidence of native tool calling.

description.value: Dense multimodal safety classifier pruned from Llama 4 Scout, producing safety labels for text and image prompts and responses.
description.note: Summarizes the documented architecture, origin, modalities and classifier output without general-assistant claims.

patch.description: Dense multimodal safety classifier pruned from Llama 4 Scout, producing safety labels for text and image prompts and responses.

sources.label: Official Llama Guard 4 model card on Hugging Face

patch.notes: Meta reports nominal 12B total parameters for the dense multimodal model pruned from Scout; active parameters are not separately reported. Scout's active count does not transfer after routed experts and routers are removed. Meta’s model registry sets maximum sequence length to 8192; the original HF configuration was inaccessible. The classifier evaluates tool-related content, but native tool calling and a dedicated reasoning mode are not disclosed. Original release is April 29, 2025; the custom license incorporates multimodal EU restrictions with an end-user exception.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains Meta's explicit nominal 12B multimodal total. Reopened Meta GitHub/Hugging Face cards and architecture documentation, and checked later Qwen3Guard and GuardReasoner-Omni comparison reports; none defines a separate active count for this model, so active_parameters_b remains null. Scout's 17B active count cannot transfer through the documented pruning. Preserved the other 12 field assessments, including dense architecture, 8192 context, original April 29 release, license, and undisclosed reasoning/tool calling.
